description:
A hospital needs to create a weekly schedule for its nurses working the night shift from 12 PM to 8 AM. The demand for nurses during the night shift varies each day of the week. For each day, there is a specific number of nurses required.
Each nurse works for a certain number of consecutive days on the night shift, followed by several days off, ensuring they have a balanced work-rest schedule over the week. The challenge is to determine the minimum number of nurses the hospital needs to hire to meet the varying daily demands for the night shift throughout the week.

T.definition: Total number of days in the scheduling period

Period.definition: Number of consecutive days each nurse works

Demand.definition: Number of nurses required on each day

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of nurses the hospital needs to hire to satisfy the daily night shift demand requirements over the scheduling period."

constraints.description: The total number of nurses assigned to work on each day must be greater than or equal to the required Demand for that day
Each nurse must work exactly Period consecutive days within the T-day planning horizon (cyclic if the schedule repeats weekly), and is off on all other days
The number of nurses assigned to start their work period on any given day must be a non-negative integer
